name: Porcelain Brief • Luxury kit
description: Draft — ceramic whites; not Atelier until silhouette is unique vs Vellum.

slides.title: Porcelain Brief.
items: Quiet type on ceramic white — the room hears the pause before the claim.

slides.title: Speak softly.
items: Luxury decks fail when they shout. Porcelain keeps the plate empty enough that one sentence can ring.
Whitespace is the product. Do not fill it with chrome.
A soft rim holds the plate without a hard card border.
Ceramic white, warm ink, a single clay accent.

slides.title: Four finishes
items: Matte ground that absorbs light instead of fighting it.
A thin sheen on the plate — never a glass widget.
Emboss that frames without boxing the copy.

slides.title: The kiln
items: Used once per page — never as a theme wash.
The plate is the stage. Protect its quiet.
Type that sits in the glaze, not on a sticker.

slides.title: Quiet is the luxury.
items: If the plate looks busy, the brand already lost.

slides.title: Studio light.
items: Morning on the bench — unfired plates catching the only soft window in the room.

slides.title: Set the plate.
items: One sentence. One rim. Leave the rest of the clay unworked.
